tasks.gr10-internet-services-text-files-t4: Topic: Internet Services and Text Files. Cover online storage, synchronisation, collaboration, online shopping and social media with their benefits and risks, saving and loading a list box with SaveToFile and LoadFromFile, checking that a file exists, and finalising the PAT with comments and testing. Ask Grade 10 learners to choose a service, name a risk, or order the steps for saving and loading data.
